series: IDC FutureScape: Worldwide IT Industry Predictions; IDC FutureScape: Worldwide CIO Agenda Predictions

futurescapes.name: Worldwide IT Industry
futurescapes.title: IDC FutureScape: Worldwide IT Industry 2026 Predictions
futurescapes.note: The report is a slide presentation with no public table of contents. The ten predictions are read from IDC's own blog post (October 22, 2025), which numbers them 1 to 10.

futurescapes.name: Worldwide CIO Agenda
futurescapes.title: IDC FutureScape: Worldwide CIO Agenda 2026 Predictions
futurescapes.note: Slide presentation (39 slides); the abstract states 'top 10 predictions' but no public page lists them. IDC's umbrella FutureScape 2026 press release (October 23, 2025) quotes seven predictions without naming the FutureScape each comes from, so none is attributed here.

entries.quote: By 2026, a renewed focus on explainability and reliability drives 70% of organizations to adopt composite AI, blending generative, prescriptive, predictive, and agentic technologies.
entries.subject: Composite AI adoption
entries.metric: share of organizations adopting composite AI

entries.quote: By 2027, G2000 agent use will jump 10x and token/call loads 1,000x, making agent vetting, orchestration, and optimization essential IT responsibilities
entries.subject: AI agent use in the G2000

entries.quote: By 2028, 45% of IT product and services interactions will use agents as the primary interface for ongoing operations.
entries.subject: Agents as IT interface
entries.metric: share of IT product and services interactions using agents as primary interface

entries.quote: By 2029, organizations that measure AI-human collaboration will have margins up to 15% higher than those focusing solely on productivity.
entries.subject: AI-human collaboration metrics
entries.metric: margin advantage of organizations measuring AI-human collaboration

entries.quote: By 2029, 30% of global IT services will be delivered as modular, platform-enabled products, driven by demand for speed, transparency, GenAI, and Agentic AI-enabled autonomous service orchestration.
entries.subject: Modular IT services
entries.metric: share of global IT services delivered as modular, platform-enabled products

entries.quote: By 2027, the massive computational and data demands of AI will compel 80% of organizations to modernize legacy cloud environments by shifting to new platforms specifically designed for AI workloads
entries.subject: Cloud modernization for AI
entries.metric: share of organizations modernizing legacy cloud for AI workloads

entries.quote: By 2028, 60% of enterprises will collaborate on data via private data exchanges or clean rooms on a broad variety of use cases, including data federation for generative and agentic AI.
entries.subject: Data clean rooms and exchanges
entries.metric: share of enterprises collaborating on data via private exchanges or clean rooms

entries.quote: By 2030, quantum-accelerated supercomputing will be used by the US, EU, and China governments for solving 50% of complex defense and science-related problems, including breaking encryption schemes.
entries.subject: Quantum-accelerated supercomputing
entries.metric: share of complex defense and science problems solved with quantum-accelerated supercomputing (US, EU, China governments)

entries.quote: By 2029, 75% of enterprises will adopt LEO satellite connectivity to complement terrestrial networks, enabling critical satellite D2C, D2D and highspeed broadband as part of a unified digital fabric
entries.subject: LEO satellite connectivity
entries.metric: share of enterprises adopting LEO satellite connectivity

entries.quote: By 2030, 50% of enterprise AI inference workloads will be processed locally on endpoints or edge nodes, reducing cloud traffic and latency while supporting greater control over sensitive data.
entries.subject: Edge AI inference
entries.metric: share of enterprise AI inference processed on endpoints or edge nodes

notes: IT Industry list complete; CIO Agenda list not public.
